verdicts.verified: Matches game text or an official patch note, or two independent A/B sources.
verdicts.plausible: Consistent with the rules but rests on one secondary source or needs an in-game test.
verdicts.outdated: Was true before 0.5 or only works in a legacy league.
verdicts.rejected: Contradicts game text or the 0.5 rules, or comes from PoE1.

recipes.title: Minion sceptre: hunt the minion level suffix

target.stat: +# to Level of all Minion Skills

steps.text: Use Greater Orb of Transmutation on a white sceptre (item level 78+). The floor of 44 leaves only +3 and +4 of the minion level family.
If the minion level suffix did not appear, start again on a new base. No PoE2 orb rerolls a Magic item cheaply.
Add a prefix with Orb of Augmentation (Spirit or minion damage).
Make it Rare with Regal Orb, or with a Greater Essence (fills the crafted slot).
Fill prefixes with Omen of Sinistral Exaltation + Exalted Orb.

checkpoints: Keep going only if step 1 gave +4 (or +3 on a budget).
If the prefix from step 3 is poor, decide to sell or continue before Regal.
With two good prefixes and minion level, move to the desecration loop.
risks: Greater and Perfect Transmutation/Augmentation are much rarer since 0.5, so each base is expensive.
Real roll weights are unknown.

recipes.title: Minion sceptre: fracture and finish

target.stat: +# to Level of all Minion Skills

steps.text: Start from a Rare sceptre with +3 or +4 minion levels and at least 4 mods.
Use Fracturing Orb. If the minion level mod is not the one fractured, the recipe ends for this item.
Replace bad suffixes with Omen of Dextral Erasure + Chaos Orb, bad prefixes with Omen of Sinistral Erasure. Omen of Whittling is cheaper when the junk mod has the lowest mod level.
Fill open slots with Omen of Sinistral/Dextral Exaltation + Greater Exalted Orb.
If the crafted slot is free, add a Perfect Essence; pick the side it removes from with Omen of Sinistral/Dextral Crystallisation.
Finish with the desecration loop.

checkpoints: If fracture misses, sell the item.
In the Chaos step aim for T1 Spirit or critical chance.
risks: Fracturing Orbs need the matching Atlas passive specialisation (0.5).

recipes.title: Puppet Master sceptre (Adaptive + Runebinder's Alloy)

target.stat: +# to Level of all Minion Skills

steps.text: Fractured +4 minion level, Chaos Orb for T1 Spirit or crit, side-omen Exalt.
Crystallisation omen + Adaptive Alloy, socket Astrid's Creativity, second Exalt.
Crystallisation omen + The Runebinder's Alloy, then Greater/Perfect Exalted Orb and a Jawbone.

checkpoints: A second Alloy is only possible with Astrid's Creativity (one crafted mod rule).
risks: Alloys are exclusive to Runes of Aldur (poe2wiki); not usable in Forbidden Rites.
Crystallisation working on Alloys comes from a single C source.
recipes.notes: Alloys also trade on the official Currency Exchange in Forbidden Rites and Standard (checked 27 Sept 2026).

recipes.title: Caster wand or staff: +level spell prefix

target.stat: +# to Level of all Spell Skills

steps.text: Orb of Transmutation / Greater Orb of Transmutation on a white wand or staff; look for the +level prefix.
Orb of Augmentation for a cast speed style suffix.
Greater Essence of Sorcery or Alacrity to make it Rare (check the side on the essence tooltip).
Side omen + Exalted Orb.

checkpoints: Without the +level prefix, drop the base.
risks: Perfect Essence of Sorcery giving spell levels is unconfirmed; check the tooltip.

recipes.title: Energy shield helmet with minion levels

target.stat: +# to Level of all Minion Skills

steps.text: Int or hybrid energy shield helmet; Transmutation/Augmentation for minion levels and an energy shield mod.
Greater Essence of Enhancement to make it Rare (crafted slot).
Side omen + Exalted Orb.
Desecrate with a Rib. Lich omens do not work on armour.

recipes.title: Minion jewellery: Necrotic Catalyst + Catalysing Exaltation

target.stat: +# to Level of all Minion Skills

steps.text: Prepare a Rare ring or amulet with minion mods and at least one open slot.
Apply Necrotic Catalyst until quality is full (a different catalyst replaces it).
Omen of Catalysing Exaltation + Exalted Orb: consumes the quality and favours minion mods.
Reapply the catalyst before each further slam.

checkpoints: Combine with Sinistral/Dextral Exaltation when one side is full (listed as compatible, test it).
risks: The size of the chance increase is not published.
Catalysts only come from the Genesis Tree since 0.5.

recipes.title: Absent/Portent amulet: fractured-suffix desecration loop

steps.text: Leave exactly two mods on the target side: one fractured, one to be replaced. The base costs one prefix or suffix slot.
Omen of Dextral Necromancy + Preserved Collarbone.
Reveal with Omen of Abyssal Echoes; jewellery can use Liege/Sovereign/Blackblooded for a lich pool.
On a miss, Omen of Light + Orb of Annulment removes only the Desecrated mod; repeat.

risks: A crafted mod already on the item can break the setup.

recipes.title: Genesis Tree ring or belt with minion/caster weights

steps.text: Collect Hiveblood and Wombgifts (Banded = belt, Signet = ring, Ornate = amulet).
Take nodes that raise minion mod weight and higher tier ratings; spend Hiveblood.
Finish with the catalyst recipe or the desecration loop.

checkpoints: "Increased weight" nodes shift chances; they do not guarantee.
risks: Branch point limits are unconfirmed.

recipes.title: Movement speed boots with resistances

steps.text: Item level 75-80 boots; Transmutation or Greater Transmutation for movement speed.
Orb of Augmentation for a life or energy shield mod.
Greater Essence of Insulation/Thawing/Grounding makes it Rare with a resistance.
Omen of Dextral Exaltation + Exalted Orb for a second resistance.

checkpoints: No movement speed: drop the base.

recipes.title: Body armour with life or energy shield

steps.text: Greater Essence of the Body (life) or of Enhancement on a Magic base with a good defence prefix.
Omen of Greater Exaltation + Exalted Orb (adds two mods).
Clean the bad side with Omen of Sinistral/Dextral Annulment.
Rib + Necromancy omen.

risks: Essence of the Body fails if the item already has a maximum life mod (mod group rule).

recipes.title: Desecration loop (Omen of Light + Abyssal Echoes)

steps.text: Rare item with a free Desecrated slot. Jawbone for weapons and quivers, Rib for armour, Collarbone for jewellery, Cranium for jewels.
Gnawed only on item level 64 or lower; Ancient raises the floor to mod level 40.
Omen of Sinistral/Dextral Necromancy picks the side; weapons and jewellery can add a lich omen.
Reveal at the Well of Souls; reroll the three options once with Omen of Abyssal Echoes.
On a miss, Omen of Light + Orb of Annulment and go again.

checkpoints: Re-price the item after the second Omen of Light.
risks: A full item may lose a random mod to the bone (unverified); keep a slot open on the target side.

recipes.title: Perfect Essence + Crystallisation targeted swap

steps.text: Crafted slot must be free. Omen of Sinistral Crystallisation removes a prefix, Dextral a suffix; then the Perfect Essence adds its mod.
Fracture the mods you keep first; with one sacrificial mod on that side the removal is certain.

risks: Perfect Essence of Battle is +3 (two-hand/crossbow) and +2 (one-hand/bow) in 0.5; older +5/+3 guides are outdated.

recipes.title: Fracture + side omen isolation

steps.text: Fracturing Orb on a Rare with 4+ mods to lock the best mod.
With one replaceable mod left on a side, Omen of Sinistral/Dextral Erasure + Chaos Orb changes only that mod. Chaos Orb removes one mod and adds one; it never rerolls the whole item.
Or clear the slot with Omen of Sinistral/Dextral Annulment and refill with Omen of Sinistral/Dextral Exaltation.

sources.label: Chaos Orb and omen game text

recipes.title: Jewel: liquid emotions and refined catalysts

steps.text: A liquid emotion on a Rare jewel replaces a random mod with one from its set.
Refined catalysts add jewel quality (Refined Necrotic for minions).
Desecrate with a Cranium.

risks: Whether liquid emotions use the crafted slot is unknown.

recipes.title: Finish: Sanctify or Vaal

steps.text: Divine Orb first: Sanctify and Vaal multiply the current values (0.5).
Omen of Sanctification + Divine Orb sanctifies the item and locks it.
Vaal: an Infuser needs 20% quality, then Vaal Orb. Omen of Corruption is gone, so the result is pure chance.

checkpoints: Do not sanctify if the item would be unacceptable with every value at the low end.
risks: The Sanctify multiplier range (78-122%) is single-source.

recipes.title: Homogenising Exaltation/Coronation recipes
risks: These omens stopped dropping in 0.4; only old Standard copies exist.

recipes.title: Controlled Vaal with Omen of Corruption
risks: Omen of Corruption cannot be obtained since 0.5.0.

recipes.title: Recombinator recipes
risks: The Recombinator was disabled in 0.5.0 and not reopened in 0.5.5; Omen of Recombination was removed.

recipes.title: Double Perfect Essence items
risks: Impossible under the 0.5 one-crafted rule.

recipes.title: Omen of Putrefaction: all mods Desecrated, then corrupted

steps.text: Activate Omen of Putrefaction and desecrate with the matching bone: every modifier becomes an unrevealed Desecrated modifier (up to six) and the item is corrupted.
Reveal each modifier at the Well of Souls. The item cannot be changed with normal currency afterwards.

checkpoints: Only do this on a base worth gambling; the result is final.
risks: Irreversible: corrupts the item.
Outcome quality is pure chance.

sources.label: User's in-game item (Vortex Barrier, Tasalian Focus)

tests.question: Is Tier 1 in Advanced Mod Descriptions the best tier?
tests.how: Paste an Alt+Ctrl+C copy of a few Rare items. The panel compares the game's tier with its own and flags every difference.
tests.note: On the 6 real items you pasted (2 jewels, 4 wands and staves, 27 Sept 2026) all 25 modifiers show the same tier in the game's Alt+Ctrl+C text as the planner gives them; T1 is the highest level of the family (e.g. level 81 = T1, level 6 = T10).
tests.source: your Alt+Ctrl+C copies (parser fixtures jewels and spell-weapons) compared with the knowledge base tiers

tests.question: Greater and Perfect Regal, Chaos and Exalted Orbs: are the minimum modifier levels 35 and 50?
tests.how: Hover Greater and Perfect Exalted, Chaos and Regal Orbs in your stash and read 'Minimum Modifier Level'.
tests.note: Greater Exalted, Chaos and Regal Orbs: 35; Perfect: 50. Such currency cannot be used below that item level either.
tests.source: game text: the orbs' "Minimum Modifier Level" line (poe2db) and the Minimum Modifier Level keyword

tests.question: A second crafted modifier is blocked (not overwritten)?
tests.how: Use a Lesser Essence (or any Perfect Essence) on a cheap Rare that already has an essence mod and note the message.
tests.note: A second essence does not go on: the item keeps its one crafted modifier (an in-game report quoted "this item already has a crafted modifier").
tests.source: an in-game report (June 2026, claim k17), the Stratlore and Timesaver essence guides ("it will not stack"), the Crafted Modifiers keyword

tests.question: Gnawed bones only work on item level 64 or lower?
tests.how: Try a Gnawed bone on any Rare of item level 65 or more.
tests.note: Gnawed bones show "Maximum Item Level: 64".
tests.source: game text: Gnawed bones (poe2db) and the Maximum Item Level keyword

tests.question: Omen of Putrefaction in 0.5.5: all mods desecrated, item corrupted?
tests.how: Look at a Putrefaction item.
tests.note: Your corrupted Tasalian Focus (Vortex Barrier) has six Desecrated mods (September 2026).

tests.question: Can Runic Alloys be found or used in Forbidden Rites?
tests.how: Search the official trade site in Forbidden Rites for any Runic Alloy; check whether Expedition offers the Recombinator.
tests.note: Runic Alloys trade in Forbidden Rites (e.g. Mystic Alloy about 7,300 a day, Runebinder's Alloy about 1,400, 27 Sept 2026).
tests.source: official Currency Exchange data of Forbidden Rites

tests.question: Sanctify multiplier range (78-122%?)
tests.how: On a cheap Rare, write down every value, apply Omen of Sanctification + Divine Orb, compare.
tests.note: Each modifier value is multiplied by a random 78% to 122%; most crafting cannot be used afterwards.
tests.source: game text: the Sanctified Items keyword

tests.question: How big is the Omen of Catalysing Exaltation boost?
tests.how: With full catalyst quality, slam ten times with and ten times without the omen on similar items and count matching mods.
tests.note: Craft of Exile does not model Omen of Catalysing Exaltation, and poe2db, Game8 and the PoE2 crafting codex say the size is not documented. The planner uses x5 at 20% quality, adjustable.

tests.question: Omen of Whittling removes the lowest level mod (not the lowest tier)?
tests.how: Activate the omen and hover a Chaos Orb over the item: the game highlights the mod it will remove.
tests.note: It removes the lowest level modifier, not the lowest tier.
tests.source: game text: Omen of Whittling (poe2db)

tests.question: A bone on a full item removes a random mod first?
tests.how: Desecrate a cheap Rare with 3 prefixes and 3 suffixes and count the mods afterwards.
tests.note: If the modifiers are full, a random modifier is also removed.
tests.source: game text: the Desecrated Modifiers keyword

tests.question: Lich mods need item level 65+ and a Preserved or Ancient bone?
tests.how: Use a lich omen with a Gnawed bone on an item level 64 item, then on a 65+ item with a Preserved bone.
tests.note: Kurgal, Amanamu and Ulaman modifiers are level 65, and Gnawed bones stop at item level 64: lich modifiers need item level 65+ and a Preserved or Ancient bone.
tests.source: game data: modifier levels and the Gnawed bone text

tests.question: Omen of Catalysing Exaltation works together with a side exaltation omen?
tests.how: Activate both omens, then use an Exalted Orb; check that both effects applied.
tests.note: Yes: Omen of Catalysing Exaltation can be combined with Omen of Sinistral or Dextral Exaltation.
tests.source: Maxroll crafting guide: "This Omen can be combined with Omen of Sinistral Exaltation or Omen of Dextral Exaltation to target specific modifiers."

tests.question: Direction of lowest_ratio and highest_ratio in the Currency Exchange data
tests.how: Resolved from the hourly data.
tests.note: Both fields hold paired amounts {A: x, B: y}; the price of A in B is y/x. lowest/highest are that hour's price range (checked on the 25 September data).

tests.question: Does the Alt+Ctrl+C copy include mod tags?
tests.how: Copy an item with Alt+Ctrl+C and paste it into a text editor; look for words after the dash in the { ... } headers.
tests.note: Yes: the Alt+Ctrl+C headers carry the modifier tags after a dash, e.g. { Prefix Modifier "Prismatic" (Tier: 1) — Damage, Elemental, Fire, Cold, Lightning }; modifiers without tags show none. The parser reads them.
tests.source: your Alt+Ctrl+C copies (Blight Joy, Loath Ornament, Ghoul Beam, Mind Roar, Brimstone Cry, Eagle Roar)

tests.question: Do sword, axe, dagger or flail bases drop in 0.5.5?
tests.how: Search the trade site of the current league for a Rare of those classes.
tests.note: Not obtainable in 0.5.x; they are expected with 1.0.
tests.source: community sources (Fextralife wiki, official forum); the trade site lists no such bases

tests.question: Can Astrid's Creativity be obtained in Forbidden Rites?
tests.how: Check the Verisium Remnant runewords available to you in Forbidden Rites.
tests.note: Astrid's Creativity trades in Forbidden Rites (about 9,800 a day, 27 Sept 2026).
tests.source: official Currency Exchange data of Forbidden Rites

tests.question: Does a Divine Orb reroll the values of fractured modifiers?
tests.how: Write down the value of a fractured modifier on a cheap Rare, use a Divine Orb, compare. The planner follows the game text (all modifiers) until this is settled.
tests.note: A Fractured modifier cannot be removed or altered; the planner leaves its values alone.
tests.source: game text: the Fractured Modifiers keyword

tests.question: Do essences check item level (for example a level 72 essence modifier on an item level 64 item)?
tests.how: Use a Greater or Perfect Essence whose modifier level is above the item level of a cheap item and see whether the game allows it. Found by the self-test: the data does not say.
tests.note: No: an essence adds its modifier whatever the item level (a level 72 essence modifier can go on an item level 64 item). The planner already works that way.
tests.source: Craft of Exile (its PoE2 emulator enables an essence for every base it applies to and never compares its modifier level with the item level; accepted as correct at your request, 28 Sept 2026)

tests.question: Can a Fracturing Orb be used on an item that already has a fractured modifier?
tests.how: Hover a Fracturing Orb over a Rare with a fractured modifier and 4+ modifiers. Found by the self-test: the game text does not say; the planner fractures at most once.
tests.note: Fracturing Orbs cannot be used on Fractured items.
tests.source: game text: Fracturing Orb (poe2db)

tests.question: What does a Flux do when the item already has a resistance of the target element (for example Blazing Flux on an item with Fire and Cold Resistance)?
tests.how: Try a Blazing Flux on a cheap item with both Fire and Cold Resistance and note the result. Found by the self-test: two modifiers of one group would result.
tests.note: Every resistance modifier of the other elements turns into the same tier of the target element with its value rolled again, even when the item has that resistance already: the item ends with two modifiers of one element. The planner now plans it that way.
tests.source: poe2wiki Blazing Flux ("this can result in an item with multiple resistance modifiers of the same type") and the u4n flux guide (two resistances both convert, same tier, new value)

tests.question: Can Orbs of Transmutation, Regal Orbs or Orbs of Alchemy be used on jewels?
tests.how: Try an Orb of Transmutation on a Normal jewel, or a Regal Orb on a Magic jewel. A game-data flag (column name guessed by the community) suggested jewels could not be upgraded.
tests.note: Yes: jewels are crafted like other gear (Transmutation, Augmentation, Regal, then Exalted Orbs). The game-data flag was a guess and is not used.
tests.source: Maxroll crafting guide: "It's a good idea to Transmute, Augment, Regal and then Exalt Jewels to the four modifier limit."

tests.question: What does a Gnawed bone reveal on a Rare of item level 64 or lower?
tests.how: Desecrate a cheap Rare of item level 64 or lower with a Gnawed bone and reveal it at the Well of Souls. The desecrated-only equipment modifiers in the game data are all level 65.
tests.note: Base modifiers: the Well of Souls offers base modifiers that could roll on the item as well as desecrated-only ones, and the desecrated-only equipment ones need item level 65, so a Gnawed bone (item level 64 or lower) reveals base modifiers only. The planner now plans desecration below item level 65 that way.
tests.source: poe2db Desecrated Modifiers ("Reveal desecrated modifiers may include base modifiers"), Sift and Game8 desecration guides; your staves show a Desecrated T1 base modifier

tests.question: Can a sceptre be desecrated?
tests.how: Try a Preserved Jawbone on a Rare sceptre. No desecrated-only modifier in the game data can roll on sceptres.
tests.note: Yes, with base modifiers only: sceptres have no desecrated-only modifier, and the Well of Souls offers base modifiers too. Not tried in game yet; the planner now offers it.
tests.source: poe2db Desecrated Modifiers community note ("Sceptres do not have exclusive desecrated modifiers") and R_DESECRATE_REVEAL

tests.question: After the "+1 Prefix/Suffix Modifier allowed" mod is removed, can a Rare jewel take a fifth regular modifier?
tests.how: Settled so far (two trade jewels you pasted, 27 Sept 2026): with the allowance mod a jewel holds 4 regular modifiers and the crafted one, 5 in total (3 prefixes + 2 suffixes, or 2 + 3). Open: guides say a side stays at 3 after the allowance mod is removed, so the other side can be filled for 5 regular modifiers. Test: remove the allowance mod (Orb of Annulment with the side omen of its side) and try an Exalted Orb with the omen of the other side. The planner follows the game data and the guides until then.
tests.note: No: a Rare jewel holds 2 prefixes and 2 suffixes; a "+1 Prefix/Suffix Modifier allowed" mod raises one side only while it is on the jewel. Once it is removed no fifth regular modifier can be added (the modifiers already there stay).
tests.source: Craft of Exile (jewels: 4 modifiers, 2 + 2), Maxroll ("Jewels have a limit of four modifiers — two prefixes and two suffixes") and your report

tests.question: When the side of the new modifier is full, does a Perfect essence or a liquid emotion remove a modifier of that side?
tests.how: Without an omen, use a cheap Perfect essence on a Rare whose side for the essence modifier is full (or a liquid emotion on such a jewel), and see which modifier goes. Players report that it removes one of that side. The planner plans it that way and uses an Omen of Crystallisation only to remove from the other side.
tests.note: Yes: without an Omen of Crystallisation, a Perfect essence (or Runic Alloy) whose modifier side is full removes a modifier of that side; otherwise any modifier can go. The omens pick the side. The planner does exactly this.
tests.source: Craft of Exile (its Perfect essence code removes from the essence modifier's side when that side is full), players' reports, the Mobalytics essence guide

tests.question: Which modifier does Potent Liquid Contempt or Ferocity add: the prefix or the suffix one?
tests.how: Use one on a full Rare jewel and note which side lost a modifier and which modifier came in. The game table lists a prefix and a suffix modifier for each jewel. The planner assumes the one on the side the removal opened, at random when both sides have room.
tests.note: The added modifier sits on the side the removal opened: "(40-60)% increased Effect of Suffixes" and "+1 Suffix Modifier allowed" are prefixes; "(40-60)% increased Effect of Prefixes" and "+1 Prefix Modifier allowed" are suffixes.
tests.source: your in-game report (27 Sept 2026), the game data (sides of the modifiers) and the MMOexp jewel guide (50/50 by the removed side)

tests.question: Does one element's spell modifier keep another element's off wands and staves?
tests.how: On the trade site (Forbidden Rites, item category Wand, then Staff), search each pair; the game data says the first three find nothing. 1) "#% increased Fire Damage" with "+# to Level of all Cold Spell Skills". 2) "#% increased Cold Damage" with "#% increased Flammability Magnitude". 3) "+# to Level of all Lightning Spell Skills" with "#% increased Freeze Buildup". Check: "#% increased Fire Damage" with "+# to Level of all Fire Spell Skills" should find items. The stopping is one-way in places: an Ignite (Flammability) suffix does not stop "+# to Level of all Physical Spell Skills", but that suffix stops Ignite.
tests.note: Your trade searches (27 Sept 2026): wands 0 results for the three pairs, the check pair found (Brimstone Cry). Staves: the Cold/Lightning pair 0; two staves carry a pair, each with something outside normal rolling: Ghoul Beam has the Cold spell levels fractured, and on Mind Roar (a Gelid Staff, whose own tags keep Fire spell modifiers off) the Fire lines show no tier, so they did not roll there. Both staves carry Passion of Aldur runes, which turn Cold and Lightning modifiers into Fire ones while the fractured modifier stays (t30). Natural rolls keep to the rule.
tests.source: your trade searches and items (Brimstone Cry, Eagle Roar, Ghoul Beam, Mind Roar); game data adds_tags and base tags

tests.question: Does the Verisium Anvil keep an item's modifiers when it turns the base into its Runeforged form?
tests.how: Upgrade a cheap magic or rare item at the Verisium Anvil (for example a Rusted Cuirass, 20 Verisium) and compare its modifiers before and after. The game data gives the cost and the new base; the planner only lists the upgrade.
tests.note: Runeforging keeps the modifiers (fractured ones too since the 0.5.1 hotfix). It adds Runic Ward; bases from level 55 give up part of their Armour, Evasion or Energy Shield for it (0.5.3 lowered that loss by about 20%). Uniques move to their Runeforged base and stay the same unique.
tests.source: your in-game report (27 Sept 2026), the game tables Expedition2VerisiumCrafts and ArmourTypes, and the PoE2Path runeforging guide

tests.question: Which catalysts can be applied to a Grasping Mail ("Catalysts can be applied to this item")?
tests.how: Try a ring and amulet catalyst (for example Flesh Catalyst) and a Refined one on a Grasping Mail. Its implicit also lets it roll ring modifiers; the planner assumes the ring and amulet catalysts work.
tests.note: Grasping Mail takes every catalyst that works on rings and amulets and rolls like a ring.
tests.source: your in-game report (27 Sept 2026); its implicits say "Can roll Ring Modifiers" and "Catalysts can be applied to this item"

tests.question: Which route puts two spell modifiers of different elements on one staff (Ghoul Beam, Mind Roar), and does a fractured modifier still keep other elements off?
tests.how: Tell in which league the two staves are listed. Mind Roar has Fire lines a Gelid Staff cannot roll (no tier shown): a route that ignores the base, such as the Recombinator, if Expedition brought it back in 0.5.5 (Expedition is core content again in Standard and Forbidden Rites). To test the fracture part: on a wand with a fractured "+# to Level of all Cold Spell Skills", use Exalted Orbs with Omen of Sinistral Exaltation and see whether "#% increased Fire Damage" ever comes.
tests.note: The Runes of Aldur: Passion of Aldur turns Cold and Lightning modifiers into equivalent Fire ones (Breath: Cold, Ire: Lightning, Betrayal: Chaos) while socketed; fractured modifiers stay. Both staves carry Passion of Aldur. The Recombinator was removed with 0.5.0 (your research).
tests.source: rune texts in the game data (augments), the two staves (Ghoul Beam, Mind Roar) and your report on the Recombinator (27 Sept 2026)

tests.question: How many of the three Well of Souls options are desecrated-only?
tests.how: Reveal a few desecrated modifiers on item level 65+ gear without a lich omen and count options that name a lich (Amanamu's, Kurgal's, Ulaman's) against base modifiers.
tests.note: One, two or three of the three options are desecrated-only with chances 80%, 15% and 5%; the rest are base modifiers of the side. With a lich omen the first option is that lich's. Without a desecrated-only modifier (sceptres, equipment below item level 65) all three are base modifiers. The planner uses these numbers.
tests.source: Craft of Exile (poe2.js: desecrationModSpawnRate = [0.8, 0.15, 0.05]); Game8 and Sift agree on at least one
